jobs.title: Future Builder - Strategic Sourcing
jobs.description:
We are Lennar
Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates.
We build quality homes and provide exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career.
Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

What is the "Future Builders" program?
Lennar's Future Builders Program is designed for highly motivated early career professionals seeking to launch their careers. Participants will develop essential interpersonal and technical skills while working alongside seasoned professionals in a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture.
Through structured onboarding, hands-on training, and professional development, Future Builders will contribute to impactful projects and gain deep exposure to key areas across Lennar. High-performing participants may have the opportunity to transition into full-time roles upon program completion.
The Technology track is a one-year, developmental program for recent graduates that prepares participants for careers in core business operations. The start date for the program will be June 2027.

Job Responsibilities: Future Builder - Strategic Sourcing
- Review IT contract documentation for completeness and accuracy
- Coordinate contract intake and routing between internal teams and vendors
- Support RFP, RFI, and sourcing event issuance and evaluation
- Gather business and technical requirements from stakeholders for sourcing initiatives
- Track vendor performance issues and escalate concerns
- Maintain sourcing records and documentation in company systems
- Analyze pricing proposals and vendor quotes
- Support spend analysis and market research to identify cost-saving opportunities
- Participate in team meetings and process improvement initiatives

Qualifications
- Current senior or recent graduate between May 2026 and May 2027.
- Authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
- Curious, proactive, and comfortable asking questions to learn and grow.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to engage in real business discussions.
- Positive, adaptable mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges and responsibilities.

Upon program completion, the Company will decide whether to offer high-performing RCGs a regular full-time position within similar roles under these verticals, based on factors such as job performance and business needs. It is important to note that placement in the Company post-program is not guaranteed.
Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

- Support the Land Acquisition team in researching potential land opportunities.

- Assist with due diligence activities and project tracking.

- Participate in acquisition meetings and project updates.

- Gain exposure to entitlement and rezoning processes.

- Maintain reports, contracts, maps, and acquisition documentation.

- Support market research and long-range planning efforts.

Land Development

- Support residential land development projects by monitoring schedules, budgets, permits, and milestones.

- Assist with coordinating contractors, consultants, and field partners.

- Participate in site visits and field inspections.

- Review engineering plans, environmental studies, and  permit  documents.

- Assist with budgets, project costs, and compliance documentation.

- Develop an understanding of the full land development lifecycle.

Construction

- Support Construction Managers in overseeing daily community site activities and trade partner performance.

- Conduct regular site walks to  monitor  progress, quality, schedule  accuracy  and readiness.

- Help  maintain  safe, clean, and organized community sites.

- Assist with project documentation, purchase orders, and construction records.

- Support invoice validation, daily logs, and issue resolution.

- Partner with Sales, Customer Care, and Operations teams.

Purchasing

- Gain hands-on experience with core purchasing systems, including  BuildPro

- Own live cost-tracking projects and help reconcile material and labor cost changes across active communities.

- Participate in trade negotiations, SOW reviews, and vendor meetings alongside senior purchasing leaders.

- Build compliance and specification packages covering LEED, ADA, and buyer premium program requirements.

- Learn to read site plans and perform simulated takeoffs (SIMs), a specialized homebuilding skill.

- Partner with a purchasing mentor and rotate through areas such as material tracking, invoicing, and ticketing systems.

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management , Civil Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.

Job Responsibilities: Future Builder - Financial Analyst

- Process and code incoming invoices to appropriate GL accounts, verify PO matching accuracy, and coordinate with Vendor Management and Accounts Payable teams
- Support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles by gathering data, building models, and validating results
- Maintain cost center records and assist with chargeback allocations and reconciliation of utility and prepaid accounts
- Identify, scope, and help implement automation opportunities within finance workflows using AI-assisted solutions
- Participate in finance process transformation initiatives, documenting current-state workflows and recommending improvements
- Contribute to a collaborative, high-performance team culture

- Current senior or recent graduate between May 2026 and May 2027.
- Completing a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or related field
- 1-3 years of experience in finance, accounting, or a related analytical role
- Foundational knowledge of financial concepts including financial modeling, journal entry development, monthly/quarterly P&L reporting (GAAP), and GL management
- Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic modeling)
- Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Word, PowerPoint)
- Exposure to or coursework in data analytics, automation tools (Power Automate, Python, RPA), or AI/ML concepts preferred
- Experience with or understanding of ERP/invoicing systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Coupa) is a plus
- Willingness to work on-site at Miami headquarters 5 days per week
- Authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
- Curious, proactive, and comfortable asking questions to learn and grow.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to engage in real business discussions.
